mentions.name: Jim's BBS
mentions.description: A message board that recreates the feel of running an 80's/90's BBS (bulletin board system). Visitors can browse the board publicly, and posting requires joining via a registration code.
mentions.problem: Recapturing the fun of running an 80's/90's BBS.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've stood up a message board to try to recapture the fun of running an 80's/90's BBS. You can look around at :

https://jims-bbs.com/bbs/
mentions.author: jim_lawless
